body:
**The openmods page**
- **openmods** has its own entry in the menu: the open-source mods listed for your game on [openmods.nexus](https://openmods.nexus), with search and sort. One click installs a mod, and one click updates it.
- **Mods | Tools:** the mods, or the tools such as UE4SS. Every card shows the mod's type, and the **Type** filter shows one type at a time. **MOD TYPE INFO** explains each type.
- **Hide installed** leaves out what you already have. The app keeps your choice.
- **Full view** shows the page over the whole window, as a grid of cards with **Page** and **Source** buttons.
- On the **Mods** page, a mod installed from openmods links to its page there, in orange, and its update installs with one click.

**Also new**
- **Japanese and Korean:** choose in Settings ▸ Language.
- **Mod types:** pak mods with `.utoc` and `.ucas` files are **PAK** too. Mods in PBZModLoader's `mods` folder have their own type, **PBZModLoader**, and their data files count as settings: you can edit them, an update keeps them, and an uninstall backs them up.
- **Tray icon only:** a new switch in Settings ▸ Tray icon removes the taskbar button. Minimize then hides the window in the tray.
- **No flash at start:** the window shows once it is drawn.
- **Shadows** on the window and its popups, and a dimmer border while the window is not in front.
- **Show files** no longer lists a settings file that a mod writes beside its own.
- **Update check:** versions such as `0.5.2.withHP` and `1.2a` on a mod page are read correctly (#22).
- **For scripts:** `UEModManager.exe --cli` lists, installs, enables, disables and uninstalls mods, backs up saves and manages UE4SS. `UEModManager.exe --cli --help` lists the commands.

**Thanks** to CooperZhuang for the command line tool and the settings file fix (#25, #26, #28, #29, #30), and to HumanMus1c for the shadows (#27) and the report on the update check (#22).

**Install:** unzip `uemm_2.2.0.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. One zip for every game. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays. `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_2.2.0.zip` is the same file under its old name, for older versions of the app.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
